description: The oracle's coverage gate (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/evidence.py:215) turns a SHIP into "pending: incomplete" when the reviewer's trace doesn't show a read of every changed file: "the verdict would ship but its trace shows no read of …". On a PR with many changed paths, the reviewer can't meet that, so the gate can never pass. Retries and `make oracle-review-recover` give the same result, and the only way through is the owner's stand-in. The gate should scale with the PR: count files that are deleted outright or are generated or data files as covered by a summary, or let the reviewer cover a large diff in bounded chunks with a merged verdict. Make sure any such rule can't let unreviewed code through.
